title_en: Near Lake I Thate, 2+1+2 apartment for sale with a regular floor plan!!
description_en: At Liqeni i Thate, near Radisson Hotel, 2+1+2 apartment for sale with a regular floor plan!! The apartment is located on the 4th floor of a 5-story building and is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette and access to the balcony, two bedrooms, two bathrooms and two balconies.
